focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asian wafers, advanced packaging, server systems, industrial machinery and site utilities

throughline.zh: 台積電與日月光公布晶圓及封測收入，中科揭露擴建二期水電工程進度，和碩與英業達則更新伺服器相關營運資料。
throughline.en: TSMC and ASEH reported foundry and OSAT revenue, CTSP detailed Phase II utilities progress, and Pegatron and Inventec disclosed server-related operations.

text.zh: 台積電 10 月營收 5,868.9 億元，年增 59.7%、月增 14.7%；未分列製程及封裝出貨。
text.en: TSMC reported NT$586.89B October sales, up 59.7% YoY and 14.7% MoM, without process-level shipments.

text.zh: 日月光投控 10 月合併營收 886.15 億元，其中封測及材料 568.4 億元，後者是集團收入的一部分。
text.en: ASEH recorded NT$88.615B October group sales, including NT$56.84B from packaging, testing and materials.

text.zh: 中科擴建二期防災與水保設施已完工，一期水電供應設施目標 2026 年底就緒。
text.en: CTSP Phase II has completed retention and soil-conservation works, with first-stage power and water targeted for end-2026.

text.zh: 和碩 10 月營收 1,880.75 億元、年增 59.6%，伺服器出貨增加但通訊產品月減。
text.en: Pegatron reported NT$188.075B October sales, up 59.6% YoY, with server growth and sequentially lower communications shipments.

text.zh: 英業達第三季營收 2,720.94 億元、年增 54%；2027 年伺服器雙位數成長仍是公司預測。
text.en: Inventec reported NT$272.094B Q3 sales, up 54% YoY; double-digit 2027 server growth remains a management forecast.

title.zh: 台積電公布 10 月營收 5,868.9 億元，年增 59.7%、月增 14.7%
title.en: TSMC reports NT$586.89B October sales, up 59.7% YoY and 14.7% MoM

summary.zh: 台積電 11 月 10 日於台灣公布 2026 年 10 月合併營收約 5,868.9 億元，較 9 月增 14.7%，較 2025 年 10 月增 59.7%；今年 1 至 10 月累計約 4.48562 兆元，年增 43.3%。公司公告的是合併營收，沒有揭露 2 奈米晶圓、CoWoS 封裝或特定客戶的個別出貨量。
summary.en: TSMC published October 2026 consolidated revenue of approximately NT$586.89 billion on November 10, up 14.7% MoM and 59.7% YoY. January–October revenue reached about NT$4.48562 trillion, up 43.3% YoY; no individual 2nm wafer, CoWoS package or customer shipment figures were disclosed.

text.zh: 台積電經營晶圓代工及先進封裝相關製造服務，供應晶片設計客戶。中央社引述市場分析將增長與先進製程需求及 2 奈米出貨提升連結，但台積電本次月報沒有提供可獨立核實的製程別營收，應將分析師歸因與公司原始披露分開。
text.en: TSMC supplies foundry manufacturing and advanced packaging services to chip designers. CNA quoted analysts linking growth to advanced-node demand and higher 2nm shipments, but this month's company release has no process-specific revenue breakdown; those interpretations are not company-disclosed attribution.

text.zh: 公司 11 月 10 日原始新聞稿公布 10 月約 5,868.9 億元，較 9 月增 14.7%，前十月累計 4 兆 4,856.17 億元。公司 2025 年官方月報列出當年 10 月營收約 3,674.73 億元，可作為年對年比較基期；因公開表格採百萬元整數顯示，圖表保留相同精度。
text.en: TSMC's November 10 company release reports NT$586.89 billion for October and NT$4,485.617 billion year to date. Its 2025 official monthly series lists NT$367.473 billion for October 2025, providing an explicitly published YoY comparison base at NT$ million precision.

text.zh: 2 奈米獨立營收、晶圓出貨片數、產能利用率、先進封裝客戶驗收與特定機台需求仍未揭露。
text.en: Revenue attributable to 2nm, wafer shipments, utilization, advanced packaging customer acceptance and tool requirements were not disclosed.

title.zh: 日月光投控 10 月營收 886.15 億元，其中封測及材料 568.4 億元
title.en: ASEH October revenue reaches NT$88.615B, including NT$56.84B from packaging, testing and materials

summary.zh: 日月光投控於 11 月 10 日公布 10 月自結合併營收 886.15 億元，月增 0.6%、年增 47.13%；其中封裝測試及材料營收 568.4 億元，月增 7.9%、年增 57.7%。前十月合併營收 6,975.02 億元，年增 32.18%；封測及材料收入屬於集團合併營收的一部分，不能重複相加。
summary.en: ASE Technology Holding reported unaudited October consolidated revenue of NT$88.615 billion on November 10, up 0.6% MoM and 47.13% YoY. Packaging, testing and materials accounted for NT$56.84 billion, up 7.9% MoM and 57.7% YoY, as a component of group sales; January–October consolidated revenue was NT$697.502 billion, up 32.18%.

text.zh: 日月光旗下封測業務涵蓋先進封裝、晶片測試、材料及傳統封測，集團亦經營電子製造服務。中央社指出 AI 晶片需求影響先進封測 LEAP 業務，但單月封測及材料營收並未再細分 LEAP、CoWoS 後段或共同封裝光學 CPO。
text.en: ASEH's operations include advanced packaging, chip testing, materials, legacy services and electronics manufacturing. CNA linked the advanced LEAP service to AI chip activity, but October's packaging/test/materials subtotal was not further separated into LEAP, CoWoS-related back-end work or co-packaged optics.

text.zh: 10 月集團營收較 2025 年同期增加 47.13%，封測及材料增加 57.7%；前十月合併營收年增 32.18%。公司先前法說提出 2026 年 LEAP 年營收 40 億美元及 2027 年倍增目標，仍為公司預估，不能與本次 10 月已實現營收加總。
text.en: The newly reported October growth rates were 47.13% for the group and 57.7% for packaging, testing and materials; ten-month group sales rose 32.18%. Earlier guidance projected US$4 billion in annual LEAP revenue for 2026 and a doubling in 2027, which remains guidance and is not added to October actuals.

text.zh: 先進封裝實際出貨、封裝良率、LEAP 月度營收、CPO 客戶驗收及封測機台利用率未獨立揭露。
text.en: Actual advanced-package shipments, yields, monthly LEAP revenue, CPO customer acceptance and back-end tool utilization were not separately disclosed.

title.zh: 中科公布擴建二期水電工程進度，一期供應設施預定年底就緒
title.en: Central Taiwan Science Park updates Phase II utilities, targeting first-stage power and water readiness by year-end

summary.zh: 中部科學園區管理局 11 月 10 日發布工程進度，台中園區擴建二期總面積約 89.75 公頃，約 50 公頃已由指標廠商承租；防災滯洪池及水土保持設施已完工，自來水、污水、道路與電力工程持續推進。管理局預計第一期廠區水電供應設施於 2026 年底前就緒，2028 年量產及超過 1 兆元建廠投資仍是規劃。
summary.en: On November 10, Central Taiwan Science Park Administration reported Phase II progress in Taichung, covering roughly 89.75 hectares, with around 50 hectares leased by an anchor tenant. Retention and soil-conservation works are complete, while water, sewage, road and electric infrastructure is progressing; first-stage utilities are targeted for end-2026, and 2028 production and over NT$1 trillion factory investment remain plans.

text.zh: 中科台中園區擴建二期主要引進晶圓製造及上下游材料、設備業者。公共工程包含自來水、污水、道路與電力供應，終期工業用水規劃由再生水支應；工程進度與晶圓廠已完成製程設備驗收屬不同事項。
text.en: Phase II is intended for semiconductor fabs and their materials and equipment supply chains. Utilities include fresh and reclaimed water, wastewater, roads and electricity. Public infrastructure milestones do not establish commissioning of the tenant's wafer-process equipment.

text.zh: 中科最新公告指出，2026 年 1 至 9 月出口額為 7,585.46 億元，年增 58.36%，比去年同期增加 2,795.42 億元；截至 9 月底園區有 246 家廠商、65,277 名員工。園區管理局估算 2026 年營業額達 1.3 兆元，擴二全期完工後平均年產值可達 5,000 億元與增加 4,500 個工作機會，均屬官方預估。
text.en: The administration reported Jan–Sep exports of NT$758.546 billion, up 58.36% or NT$279.542 billion versus a year earlier, with 246 firms and 65,277 employees as of September. It forecast NT$1.3 trillion in 2026 park revenue and estimated Phase II's eventual NT$500 billion average annual output and 4,500 jobs, all projections rather than realized new-fab output.

text.zh: 第一期水電實際通水與通電日期、進場設備數、再生水供應比率及 2028 年實際量產與產值仍待確認。
text.en: Actual first-stage water/power connection dates, installed tools, reclaimed-water share and 2028 production and output remain unverified.

title.zh: 和碩 10 月營收 1,880.75 億元，伺服器出貨成長、通訊產品月減
title.en: Pegatron October sales reach NT$188.075B as servers grow but communications decline sequentially

summary.zh: 和碩 11 月 10 日公布 10 月合併營收約 1,880.75 億元，月減 12.4%、年增 59.6%；前十月累計約 1.096 兆元、年增 19.7%。公司表示資訊與消費性產品營收較 9 月增加，其中伺服器成長幅度較大，但通訊產品出貨下降，尚未公布伺服器個別營收或機櫃數量。
summary.en: Pegatron reported October consolidated revenue of roughly NT$188.075 billion on November 10, down 12.4% MoM but up 59.6% YoY; January–October sales reached approximately NT$1.096 trillion, up 19.7%. The company said information and consumer electronics increased from September, especially servers, while communications shipments declined; server revenue and rack units were not separated.

text.zh: 和碩經營整機代工，包括通訊、資訊、消費電子和伺服器。合併營收變化同時反映不同產品出貨時序，因此整體月減與伺服器業務月增可以同時發生；公司未提供伺服器特定平台的可比較數據。
text.en: Pegatron is an ODM spanning communications, computing, consumer electronics and servers. Consolidated sequential revenue can decline even while server business grows due to separate product lines and shipment timing, with no platform-specific comparison released.

text.zh: 中央社引述和碩指出，10 月三大產品線皆較 2025 年同期成長，9 月則是歷史營收高點，10 月為歷來次高。公司預計 11 月 12 日法說更新第四季及 2027 年展望，相關前瞻說法尚未公布。
text.en: According to CNA's direct company response, each of three business segments grew from October 2025, while September had been the all-time revenue high and October the second-highest. Pegatron plans a November 12 briefing for Q4 and 2027 commentary; unreleased guidance is not included.

text.zh: 伺服器與通訊各自金額、機櫃電源與冷卻配置、不同客戶驗收及新訂單規模未披露。
text.en: Separate server and communications amounts, rack power/cooling specifications, customer acceptance and new order values remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 英業達法說公布第三季營收 2,720.94 億元，預期 2027 年伺服器出貨雙位數成長
title.en: Inventec reports NT$272.094B Q3 sales and forecasts double-digit server shipment growth in 2027

summary.zh: 英業達於 11 月 10 日法人說明會公布第三季合併營收 2,720.94 億元，季增 1%、年增 54%；歸屬母公司淨利 25.38 億元、季減 35%，每股盈餘 0.71 元。公司表示目前雲端客戶需求及德州廠布局未因選舉而改變，預期 2027 年 GPU 與 ASIC 伺服器出貨及收入雙位數成長，仍屬管理階層預測。
summary.en: Inventec reported Q3 consolidated revenue of NT$272.094 billion on November 10, up 1% QoQ and 54% YoY, and attributable net income of NT$2.538 billion, down 35% QoQ, with EPS of NT$0.71. Management said current cloud-customer orders and the Texas factory strategy remain unchanged, while forecasting double-digit GPU and ASIC server revenue and shipment growth in 2027.

text.zh: 英業達經營伺服器 ODM、筆電及智慧裝置，第三季毛利率 4.2% 與第二季持平，年減 0.8 個百分點。GPU 與 ASIC 伺服器為目前伺服器出貨的主要組合，但公司尚未提供兩類機種個別金額或機櫃驗收。
text.en: Inventec is an ODM for servers, notebooks and smart devices. Its Q3 gross margin was 4.2%, flat sequentially and down 0.8 percentage points YoY. GPU and ASIC systems make up most current server shipments, but figures by platform or rack acceptance were not disclosed.

text.zh: 中央社 11 月 10 日引述管理層指出，第三季淨利減少部分受到利息費用較高影響；前 3 季合併營收 7,422.61 億元、年增 43%，母公司淨利 88.61 億元、年增 34%。管理階層對 2027 年伺服器需求的展望沒有公布具體出貨基期或已簽訂的新訂單金額。
text.en: CNA's November 10 briefing report cites higher interest expense as one factor behind lower Q3 attributable profit. Nine-month consolidated revenue was NT$742.261 billion, up 43% YoY, and attributable profit NT$8.861 billion, up 34%; the 2027 double-digit server outlook lacks a unit baseline or disclosed new contract amount.

text.zh: 德州廠具體新增產能、GPU/ASIC 伺服器獨立出貨件數、2027 年客戶確認訂單及機櫃電源規格尚未公布。
text.en: Texas factory incremental capacity, GPU/ASIC shipments, confirmed 2027 customer purchase orders and rack power configurations were not disclosed.

title.zh: 機械公會公布 10 月機械出口 35.93 億美元，電子設備出口年增 57.5%
title.en: Taiwan machinery association reports US$3.593B October exports, electronic equipment up 57.5% YoY

summary.zh: 台灣機械工業同業公會 11 月 10 日發布 2026 年 10 月機械出口統計，總出口 35.93 億美元，較 9 月增 4.5%，較去年同月 26.61 億美元增 35%；其中電子設備出口 7.89 億美元，年增 57.5%。前十月機械出口合計 315.72 億美元、年增 21.8%，涵蓋多種機械產品，不能全部視為半導體製程設備。
summary.en: Taiwan's machinery association reported October machinery exports of US$3.593 billion on November 10, up 4.5% MoM and 35% YoY against a stated US$2.661 billion year-earlier base. Electronic equipment exports within the broader category reached US$789 million, up 57.5% YoY, while ten-month machinery exports totaled US$31.572 billion, up 21.8%; the totals include non-semiconductor equipment.

text.zh: 機械公會統計涵蓋電子設備、生產機械與多種工業工具，電子設備項目和半導體專用設備仍可能存在不同產品定義。台灣機械出口市場的前三大目的地包括美國、中國大陸及新加坡，這是前十月出口結構排名，並非單月金額比較。
text.en: The machinery association counts electronics equipment alongside broad industrial machinery, and those customs categories do not equal semiconductor-only tool orders. Its top ten-month export destinations included the United States, mainland China and Singapore, a ranking over a different period than October exports.

text.zh: 公會 11 月 10 日指出，10 月機械出口為 35.93 億美元，去年同期 26.61 億美元；其中電子設備出口 7.89 億美元、年增 57.5%。全年出口續增與美國資料中心政策可能改變投資速度是公會判斷，本期不將其視為已發生的政策影響。
text.en: The association gave October machinery exports of US$3.593 billion versus US$2.661 billion a year earlier, and electronic equipment exports of US$789 million, up 57.5%. Its future export outlook and view of US data-center policy are interpretations, not realized project cancellations or enacted rules.

text.zh: 半導體製程設備獨立出口金額、各廠設備驗收、出口客戶及 2027 年正式訂單尚未公布。
text.en: Standalone semiconductor process-tool exports, factory acceptance, buyer identities and 2027 firm orders are not disclosed.

title.zh: 工具機公會 10 月統計：整機出口 1.67 億美元、關鍵零組件 1.58 億美元
title.en: Machine-tool association reports US$167M finished tool exports and US$158M parts exports in October

summary.zh: 台灣工具機暨零組件工業同業公會 11 月 10 日公布 10 月出口，整機出口 1.67 億美元，月減 0.5%、年增 18.49%；關鍵零組件出口 1.58 億美元，月增 8.1%、年增 27.4%。前十月整機出口 16.59 億美元、年減 0.2%，零組件出口 14.23 億美元、年增 14.5%，各項出口類別須分別閱讀。
summary.en: Taiwan's machine-tool and components association reported October finished tool exports of US$167 million on November 10, down 0.5% MoM but up 18.49% YoY; key components reached US$158 million, up 8.1% MoM and 27.4% YoY. Jan–Oct tools were US$1.659 billion, down 0.2% YoY, while parts were US$1.423 billion, up 14.5% YoY.

text.zh: 工具機關鍵零組件包含滾珠螺桿、線性滑軌、工作物夾持器及金屬切削／成型設備零件，供應自動化工廠與工業設備。公會指出越南、泰國與馬來西亞名列出口目的地或成長市場，但沒有提供這次各國所有品項的獨立出口金額。
text.en: Key machine-tool parts include ball screws, linear guides, workholding equipment and metal-cutting/forming accessories used in industrial automation. Vietnam, Thailand and Malaysia appear among tool export markets, but the association did not provide every country's separate October parts value.

text.zh: 公會公布前十月整機出口 16.59 億美元，較去年同期略減 0.2%；關鍵零組件前十月 14.23 億美元，年增 14.5%。單月整機年增與累計整機略減同時成立，原因是比較期間不同。
text.en: The association reported Jan–Oct finished tool exports of US$1.659 billion, down 0.2% YoY, and parts exports of US$1.423 billion, up 14.5%. October positive tool growth and a slightly negative ten-month figure refer to different periods.

text.zh: 零組件依東南亞國別的月度出口金額、工具機用於半導體設備比重及終端客戶驗收未揭露。
text.en: Country-specific October components exports, semiconductor-specific tool applications and final customer acceptance were not disclosed.

title.zh: electronica 與 SEMICON Europa 11 月 10 日在慕尼黑展開，臺灣館列出逾 250 家供應商
title.en: electronica and SEMICON Europa begin Nov 10 in Munich; TAITRA lists over 250 Taiwanese exhibitors

summary.zh: electronica 2026 與 SEMICON Europa 2026 依主辦單位公告於 11 月 10 日至 13 日在德國慕尼黑展覽中心舉行，外貿協會公布臺灣參展供應商超過 250 家。臺灣館參展範圍包含電源轉換、被動元件、連接器及工業電子，並安排 11 月 10 日開幕活動；名單及展位已公開，沒有可核對的展期成交訂單數據。
summary.en: electronica 2026 and SEMICON Europa 2026 run November 10–13 at Messe München in Germany, according to organizers, with TAITRA listing more than 250 Taiwanese suppliers at electronica. Its published exhibitor program covers power conversion, passive components, connectors and industrial electronics, including November 10 opening events; no verified orders from the show have been reported.

text.zh: 兩展涵蓋半導體製程、測試、電子零組件、工廠自動化與工業電源。外貿協會公布臺灣參展業者集中於 A3、A5、A6、B2 及 B6 展館，指標名單包含台達電、國巨、光寶科、研華、華邦電及上銀等企業；列名參展不代表現場已發布新產品或簽約。
text.en: The fairs cover semiconductor manufacturing, test, electronic components, industrial power and automation. TAITRA lists Taiwanese exhibitors mainly in halls A3, A5, A6, B2 and B6 and names Delta, Yageo, Lite-On, Advantech, Winbond and Hiwin among participants. Exhibitor listings do not establish product launches or signed orders.

text.zh: 外貿協會臺灣館排程列有 11 月 10 日 11:00 至 11:30 開幕典禮、展區導覽與交流活動，主辦單位確認展期為 11 月 10 至 13 日。SEMICON Europa 官方議程也列出 11 月 10 日開始的國際標準會議與半導體產業活動；展會不是某家台廠新建產線。
text.en: TAITRA's Taiwan pavilion agenda lists a November 10 opening ceremony from 11:00 to 11:30, guided visits and networking. SEMICON Europa's organizer program includes standards meetings and semiconductor sessions beginning November 10; this is an exhibition event, not a newly commissioned Taiwanese production line.

text.zh: 各家參展商實際新技術發表、客戶簽約、採購額及展會成果尚無可獨立核對數據。
text.en: Actual product introductions, customer contracts, purchase orders and business outcomes have not yet been independently verified.

fdi.en: No new FDI amount was disclosed.

relevance.zh: 可核對的臺灣半導體設備及電源零組件供應商在海外實體參展資訊。
relevance.en: Documented overseas exhibition activity by Taiwanese semiconductor tools and electronic power-component suppliers.

timing.zh: 展期 11 月 10 至 13 日，臺灣館開幕排定 11 月 10 日。
timing.en: Exhibition dates November 10–13; Taiwan pavilion opening scheduled November 10.

unknowns.zh: 各家參展商實際新技術發表、客戶簽約、採購額及展會成果尚無可獨立核對數據。
unknowns.en: Actual product introductions, customer contracts, purchase orders and business outcomes have not yet been independently verified.

name.zh: 臺灣參展商家數下限

owner.zh: 外貿協會

metrics.baseStatus: 外貿協會原文為超過 250 家；250 僅作保守下限，實際家數未揭露。

ceoView.zh: 對電源轉換、半導體測試設備與工業量測業者而言，外貿協會及主辦單位提供可核對的供應商名單與展區位置。仍需查核實際展示產品、客戶現場驗證及簽約成果，參展數量不代表新增採購金額。
ceoView.en: For power conversion, semiconductor testing and industrial metrology suppliers, organizer and TAITRA pages establish exhibitors and locations. Actual products, qualification and contracts remain unverified; exhibitor counts do not quantify procurement.

question.zh: 台積電營收年增是否代表 2 奈米晶圓出貨也年增 59.7%？
question.en: Does TSMC's revenue growth indicate 59.7% growth in 2nm wafer shipments?

text.zh: 59.7% 是合併營收的年增率，公司月報沒有提供 2 奈米晶圓出貨量；部分製程歸因來自外部分析。
text.en: The 59.7% applies to consolidated revenue. TSMC did not provide 2nm wafer shipment counts, and process-specific attribution came from outside analysts.

question.zh: 日月光封測及材料收入能與集團營收相加嗎？
question.en: Can ASEH's packaging and materials sales be added to total group revenue?

text.zh: 568.4 億元已包含在集團 886.15 億元中，兩者重疊，不能相加；LEAP 全年營收則屬先前展望。
text.en: NT$56.84B is included within the NT$88.615B group revenue, so the figures overlap. Annual LEAP revenue is earlier guidance.

question.zh: 中科二期水電工程進度是否代表晶圓廠已量產？
question.en: Does CTSP utility progress mean the new wafer fab is producing?

text.zh: 本次確認的是滯洪池及水保設施已完工，首期水電供應設施仍預計年底就緒；晶圓廠 2028 年量產為規劃。
text.en: Retention and soil-conservation works were completed, while first-stage utilities target year-end. Fab production in 2028 remains a plan.

title.zh: 已於前一期公布的電源及伺服器營收
title.en: Power and server revenue already covered in the previous edition

text.zh: 台達電、光寶科、廣達與華碩的 10 月收入已於 11 月 10 日日報收錄，公告事件日期為 11 月 9 日。本次未把相同月報重新列為新發展。
text.en: Delta, Lite-On, Quanta and ASUS October sales appeared in the November 10 edition with a November 9 event date. Those identical monthly releases are not republished as new developments.

title.zh: 舊有建廠承諾及股價消息
title.en: Repeated factory plans and market moves

text.zh: 未收錄舊有資料中心資本支出預告、單純股價波動，以及缺乏可核實客戶出貨量的分析師推測。
text.en: Older data-center capex plans, share-price movements and analyst speculation without verified customer shipments were excluded.

verificationNote.zh: 台積電 10 月營收已核對公司新聞稿及 2025 年官方月報。日月光、和碩、英業達與兩家機械公會的數據由中央社引述，未逐一直接取得公司或公會原始申報，故需留意來源限制。中科工程進度及出口數據由管理局對外公布、經中央社轉述；2028 年量產、未來產值與水電供應目標均屬規劃。臺灣館參展家數依外貿協會為超過 250 家，沒有展期簽約金額。
verificationNote.en: TSMC October sales were checked against its company release and official 2025 series. ASEH, Pegatron, Inventec and the two machinery associations' figures rely on CNA without every original filing independently inspected. CTSP project progress and exports are attributed to the administration through CNA; 2028 production, future output and utility readiness remain plans. TAITRA lists more than 250 Taiwanese exhibitors, with no trade-show contract amounts reported.
